skill_friction: AskCoworker D2 put an Open Decisions table after the 'Sections included' line but before the end marker; the response-handling table only covers text after the end marker, so it is unclear whether content after 'Sections included' should be kept.

org-verification.md gives no way to check a custom object's 'Allow Reports' setting (Tooling CustomObject has no Metadata column here), yet report and report-type designs depend on it; had to leave it as an assumption.

spec-format.md says to use the standard source-format folder for Module but does not say which folder holds ReportFolder/DashboardFolder metadata; AskCoworker invented reportFolders/dashboardFolders paths.

AskCoworker repeatedly tagged facts I sent it as '[Verified: prior session]'; the skill says echoed facts are already established, but the label makes it harder to separate them from genuine prior-session facts (e.g. DataStream count, which I then verified).

AskCoworker D1 claimed the region concept 'does not exist anywhere in the org' while a Region__c custom object exists; the skill's 'missed components' check caught it only because I searched sobject list by keyword, which org-verification.md does not explicitly suggest for objects (it only suggests CustomField searches).
